paragraphs: Data & Business Analyst with 3+ years across operations, marketing, finance, and revenue reporting, building the data infrastructure businesses rely on and delivering insights that drive real decisions. At Veracyte, a NASDAQ-listed genomic diagnostics company, I built a Snowflake data mart consolidating 2M+ medical claims and shipped executive Power BI & Tableau dashboards. I pair end-to-end ETL and automated data-quality engineering with ML models reaching 96% prediction accuracy and clear, decision-ready reporting. M.S. in Business Analytics & AI, UT Dallas (May 2026).
